items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The transcript describes Dr. Arthur Logan's relationship with 'him' (Joe Thomas), not the interviewee. The interviewee states: 'I wasn't working with him that Sunday afternoon but, naturally I went with him because, naturally, I was very con- cerned'.

ctx.x: him and his doctor, which was Dr. Arthur Logan, and mainly to Dr. Logan.
